page.title: Scans
page.subtitle: Scan queue across the projects you can access.
page.empty: No scans match the current filter.
page.empty_all_hint: A scan starts from a project. Open one and press Scan.

progress.title: Scan in progress
progress.cancelled_notice: This scan was cancelled. Any in-progress work has been stopped.
progress.background_notice: Scan continues in the background — you can close this panel.

errors.not_found: This scan could not be found.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this scan.
errors.validation: The address does not point at a scan.

confirm.title: Cancel scan
confirm.message: Cancel this scan? Any in-progress work will be stopped and the scan will be marked as cancelled.

errors.already_terminal: This scan already finished and can no longer be cancelled.
errors.not_found: This scan no longer exists or you no longer have access to it.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to cancel this scan.
errors.unknown: Could not cancel the scan. Please try again.

alerts.dt_unavailable: The vulnerability matcher is temporarily unavailable. Showing cached results.

container.label: Container image
container.hint: Trivy scans the image's OS packages for vulnerabilities, e.g. ghcr.io/org/app:1.2.3.
container.subtitle: Scan a container image for {{project}} with Trivy.

errors.image_required: Enter an image reference to scan.

os_eol.label: OS end-of-life
os_eol.heading: Base image OS
os_eol.detail: This image's base OS release ({{os}}) is past its end-of-service-life. It no longer receives upstream security fixes, so newly disclosed CVEs will not be patched. Rebuild on a supported release.
os_eol.note: The end-of-service-life verdict comes from Trivy's vulnerability database; a stale database may not yet flag a recently retired release.

release.label: Version
release.hint: Optional. Names the shipped unit, e.g. v1.2.3. A labelled release is exempt from retention.

verbose.label: Verbose logs (debug)
verbose.hint: Stream the full cdxgen / scancode / Trivy diagnostic trace into the scan log. Useful when debugging a scan.

source.title: Start a scan
source.subtitle: Choose how to provide the source for {{project}}.

git.label: Configured Git URL
git.missing: This project has no Git URL. Upload a .zip or select a folder instead, or add a Git URL in project settings.
git.credential_configured: Private credential configured — used at clone time.
git.credential_missing_prefix: Cloned as a public repository. For a private repo, add a token in

folder.label: Project folder
folder.hint: The folder is zipped in your browser before upload, up to {{max}}.
folder.too_large: The selected folder exceeds the {{max}} limit. Remove large directories and try again.
folder.noisy: Large directories detected: {{dirs}}. These will inflate the upload — consider excluding them.

errors.too_large: The archive is too large. The limit is 100 MiB.
errors.quota_exceeded: This project has reached its storage quota.
errors.bad_request: The upload could not be processed.
errors.network: Upload failed due to a network error. Please try again.
errors.unknown: The upload failed. Please try again.

sbom_ingest.title: Upload an SBOM
sbom_ingest.subtitle: Upload a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM for {{project}}. We match it against vulnerability and license data — no source needed.
sbom_ingest.shared_warning: Shared public sandbox: do not upload proprietary or sensitive SBOMs. Uploads are visible to other visitors and deleted periodically.

errors.too_large: The SBOM is too large to ingest. Please upload a smaller document.
errors.unsupported_type: Only CycloneDX or SPDX SBOMs are supported.
errors.invalid_document: This file is not a valid CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM.
errors.scan_in_progress: A scan is already running for this project. Wait for it to finish, then upload again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many uploads. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: Upload failed due to a network error. Please try again.
errors.unknown: The SBOM upload failed. Please try again.

conformance.title: SBOM conformance

g7.title: G7 AI SBOM minimum elements
g7.review_note: Elements marked "No automated source" cannot be verified from the SBOM alone and require human review.

crosswalk.title: Regulatory crosswalk
crosswalk.intro: Informational only — this maps the checks above to the regulatory documentation elements they touch. It is not a compliance determination.

errors.not_found: No conformance verdict is available for this scan yet.
errors.network: Could not load the conformance verdict due to a network error.
errors.unknown: Could not load the conformance verdict.

conformance.headline: {{mandatoryFailed}} mandatory check(s) failed · {{advisoryShort}} advisory element(s) short · {{needsReview}} need a person

cisa.title: 2026 SBOM minimum elements
cisa.intro: Advisory throughout — these never move the verdict above. Measured on every CycloneDX document; the 2026 elements replace the NTIA minimum elements of 2021.

ai.title: AI usage verdicts
ai.intro: How these models and datasets read for this project's intended use: {{scenario}}. Guidance for review, not a legal determination, and not tied to any build gate.

scenario.unset: not set, so the full license terms apply

provenance.title: Where these results came from
provenance.description: What this scan read, recorded while it ran. Values are what the source stated — a file being listed means it was in the tree, not that every dependency in it resolved.

document.heading: The document this scan was given
document.subject: Describes
document.claimNote: Every value above is the document's own claim about itself.

manifests.heading: Dependency manifests the scanned tree carried ({{count}})
manifests.none: The scanned tree carried no dependency manifest. A scan of it finds components only where a file declares them.
manifests.truncated: Listing stops at the recorded limit — the tree carried more

stream_stopped.title: Live updates stopped

reason.network: The connection dropped and could not be re-established.
reason.evicted: Another tab took over the live connection for this account.
reason.rejected: The server did not accept this connection.
reason.forbidden: You do not have access to this scan.
reason.missing: There is no scan with this id.
reason.at_capacity: The server is at its connection limit right now.

stream_stopped.unaffected: The scan itself is unaffected and is still running.
stream_stopped.stale: The status shown here may be out of date.
stream_stopped.stale_log: The lines below end where the stream did.
